key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) adapts prediction sets when delayed feedback and limited tracking capacity cause some outcomes to be missed.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging AI, this approach could support uncertainty estimation when outcome feedback arrives late and only a limited number of predictions can be tracked.
method: Randomly samples a proxy delay to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Uses inverse probability weighting to account for feedback lost through delays or capacity limits.
Optimizes tracking policies using risk bounds for arbitrary and stochastic delays.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments across medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, but provides no dataset details or numerical results.
watch_item: Clinical benefit is not established by the abstract, and implementation requires balancing feedback collection against tracking-capacity saturation.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
